card.title: Second Place Feels Like Disappearing
card.instruction: Treat every comparison as a threat to your worth. Respond by proving that you still matter before the moment can move on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You put the winning photograph above mine. Can people still see mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is right beside the light switch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So everyone touches that wall. Good.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a competition for attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody will mind if I stand beside it answering questions.

mechanism: A reads display ranking as a threat to personal worth and engineers more attention to their own contribution.
confusable: Unlike exhibition logistics, the reassurance must become another effort to establish continuing importance.
comparison: S207-b turns wall traffic into self-presentation; S207-a requests name repetition and gaze during a prize ceremony.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
